notice.title: Best execution reporting for equity orders
notice.aiSummary: Broker-dealers must publish quarterly reports on equity order routing venues and execution quality. Compliance is required from April 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: This notice applies only to registered broker-dealers that route customer equity orders, and Brivanta Bank does not operate a broker-dealer or route securities orders.

text:
SECURITIES MARKETS COMMISSION FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Best execution reporting for equity orders
Notice number: RCN-2026-017
Issued by: Securities Markets Commission
Published: 2026-10-30
Effective date: 2027-04-01
1. Who this applies to
Registered broker-dealers that route customer equity orders.
2. Background
Investors need to see where their orders were sent and what price they received.
3. Requirements
3.1 A broker-dealer must publish a quarterly report on the venues to which it routed customer equity orders and the execution quality obtained.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-04-01.
